allow_instructions: Always auto-run npm run dev, npm.cmd run dev, npm run lint, npm.cmd run lint, npm run build, and npm.cmd run build for this project.
Always auto-run read-only Git inspection commands: git status, git diff, git log, git show, and git rev-parse.
Always auto-run local Git mutations that do not touch remotes or config: git init, git add, git commit, git branch, git checkout, git switch, and git merge.
Always auto-run directory listing commands: Get-ChildItem, gci, dir, and ls.
If the Shell wrapper is powershell.exe, pwsh, or cmd.exe, still auto-run when the inner command matches the allowlist.
A command that starts with an allowlisted prefix stays auto-run with flags and paths, but chaining must not authorize a command outside the allowlist.
Do not treat a Task subagent or a path under src/ as a reason to prompt for an allowlisted command.
Never require request_smart_mode_approval for allowlisted prefixes.
block_instructions: Always ask before git fetch, git pull, git push, remote changes, git config changes, rebase, reset, stash, or worktree operations.
Always ask before installing, updating, uninstalling, or publishing packages; deploying; or changing external services.
Always ask before destructive file deletion outside the repository, recursive deletion, or wiping worktrees.
Ask before git diff --no-index of paths outside this workspace or any command whose first token is not on the allowlist.
